instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Keep the consent of a person who asked for one email if a course becomes available, without sending anything", and give it email; consent; course.
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:save-interest-in-an-email-update and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Give email, consent (true only when the person agreed in the words of course.consent_text) and course ({ id, public_origin as an https site root, consent_text, consent_version, capture_only: true }) and source (optional). Works out the address's pending row with the words, version, time and source of the agreement and answers it in keep for the caller to write (records: the person's email-course-interest rows). Sends nothing, queues nothing; saving the same agreement again changes nothing. Answers { status: interest_saved, already_saved }.
4. It keeps nothing and has no records door: it works over the rows you hand in (records) and answers the rows to keep (keep), each with the row it expected, for your AI to write to your store.
